title: Developing a Machine Learning Algorithm to Predict the Probability of Medical Staff Work Mode Using Human-Smartphone Interaction Patterns: Algorithm Development and Validation Study
summary: Machine-learning models used smartphone interaction patterns to distinguish staff work modes, including on-site versus off-site and work versus nonwork periods, with validation against labeled work-mode records. The result is limited to the reported samples, datasets, and assays; broader transfer and downstream utility were not established.
